visualBrief: Whole separately mapped central roofed block inside the original named Litoral Penitentiary perimeter, outside the twelve named pavilion compounds. All original full-precision numerical roof controls, complete walls and closed roof retained. Specific building function is unverified; open yards and other roofs remain separate. All imagery unused after Qualla-first inventory. Current site mapping does not establish exact2023 continuity. Actual function, facade/opening census, finish, flat roof section, small details and condition are estimates. Exact facade, openings/floor census, finish, roof section and2023 continuity are estimates with2m component uncertainty. Own original256m/129x129/16641-value field and 1 raw tiles fixed before floor.25m/foundation-1.2m/eave 3.13m/roof 3.25m. No field masking, flattening, replacement or floor/main-section refit. Precise grade/contact and vertical tie unverified. All four LODs retain every original corner, whole walls/roof/base, estimated window census and closed entry. Near levels use physical recesses and sparse bars; low-roof openings/canopy are proportionally reduced below the chosen eave. Sparse details are author estimates, not an observed architectural census. Approximate2023-12-31 historical preview/current-world eligible false.
